article.story: SPARTANBURG, S.C. -- — Jayden Tyler scored 24 points as Wofford beat NAIA-member Union of Kentucky 88-54 on Sunday. Tyler shot 7 of 8 from the field, including 5 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the line for the Terriers (8-5). Nils Machowski scored 14 points while going 6 of 13 (2 for 6 from 3-point range) and added four steals. Kahmare Holmes finished 6 of 8 from the field to finish with 12 points, while adding six steals. Ali Sakho led the way for the Bulldogs with 14 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
